paragraphs: This Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement is entered into on March 1, 2025 by and between Acme Corp and Beta LLC.
Confidential Information means any non-public information disclosed by either party.
This Agreement shall remain in effect for a period of three (3) years from the Effective Date.
The Receiving Party shall protect Confidential Information with reasonable care.
Either party may terminate this Agreement with thirty (30) days written notice.
The Receiving Party shall be liable for any breach of this Agreement.
This Agreement is governed by the laws of the State of California.
